newsitem.title: USA: Nashville Country Club sets acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Nashville Country Club sets acquisition.

text.p: Nashville Country Club Inc said Friday it signed a letter of agreement to acquire a 51 percent interest in a group of entities producing concerts and managing merchandising for entertainment and sporting events.
Terms of the agreement, made with Robert Geddes, Thomas Miserendino and Brian Murphy, were not disclosed.
The entities, collectively known as Avalon West Coast, are Irvine Meadows Amphitheatre, New Avalon Inc, Eric/Chandler Ltd, Eric Chandler Merchandising Inc and TBA Media Inc.

"With the addition of Avalon West Coast, the company is expanding its entertainment division to include amphitheater operations, concert production and event merchandising," Nashville Country said in a statement.
